steps.agent_response:
Yes, when filling out official forms that require your Social Security Number (SSN), your name spelling should match exactly what is printed on your Social Security card. 

Mismatches between the name on the form and the name associated with your SSN in government databases can lead to processing delays, rejections, or issues with tax reporting, background checks, and employment verification. 

If your name has legally changed (e.g., due to marriage or court order) or is misspelled on your card, you should update it with the Social Security Administration (SSA) to ensure all your official documents align.
